task.instruction: Browse black strollers within $100 to $200 on Amazon. Then find one Among these black strollers with over 2,000 reviews and a rating greater than 4 star.

final_answer:
I searched Amazon for "black stroller" with a $100–$200 price filter. Amazon shows prices in MYR because the delivery address is Malaysia, so that range appears as roughly MYR 406–812.

I picked the **Baby Trend Expedition® Jogger, Dash Black**:
- **Rating:** 4.7 out of 5 stars.
- **Reviews:** 5,905 ratings.
- **Price:** MYR 487.16 (list MYR 608.96), which is about $120.
- **Badge:** Amazon labels it "#1 Top Rated".
- **Page:** https://www.amazon.com/Baby-Trend-JG94F00D-Expedition%C2%AE-Jogger/dp/B0BYTKYGZ3

The **Mompush Wiz 2-in-1 Bassinet Stroller Reversible Seat, One-Hand Fold, Black** also meets both criteria. It has 4.6 stars from 3,901 ratings and costs MYR 649.56, or about $160.

The USD figures are my own conversions from the MYR prices. I only checked the first page of results (16 of 248). The page text didn't show ratings for most of the other strollers on that page, so I didn't compare them.

judge.rationale: Final page shows Baby Trend Expedition Jogger “Dash Black” at MYR 487.16 with 4.7 stars and 5.9K ratings under the $100–$200 price-filtered search.
